entities.name: Query CoaBC protein
observations: 419 aa; calculated molecular mass 45.58 kDa and theoretical pI 6.44.
Strong homology to reviewed CoaBC proteins: 39.6–41.6% identity over 92.1–93.1% query coverage, E-values 2.3e-78 to 3.15e-81.
Contains Pfam Flavoprotein domain PF02441 at residues 19–193 and DFP domain PF04127 at residues 201–408.
Likely a soluble bifunctional CoA-biosynthesis enzyme; no transmembrane segment or obvious secretion signal is evident from the sequence.
Functional assignment is homology-supported rather than experimentally demonstrated for this exact sequence.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: The inferred protein catalyzes steps 2 and 3 of CoA biosynthesis from pantothenate.
Relevant transformations are phosphopantothenate–cysteine ligation followed by phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation.

entities.name: FMN and Mg2+ cofactors
observations: Reviewed CoaBC homologs bind one FMN per subunit and use Mg2+ for the ligase reaction; these cofactors are inferred for the query by strong homology.
Cofactor assignment is not directly experimentally verified for the query sequence.
